steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Record. Each measured time is written to the test record against its target.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 scenario has no measured restore time

findings.title: Restore time not measured
findings.fix: Measure the restore and record the time

findings.title: Passed, but measured time is over the target
findings.fix: Change the result or the target

findings.title: Gap with no action
findings.fix: Name the action and its owner

outcome.notChecked: Whether the recovery works for real data at scale.
